version_number.title: Version Number
version_number.description: Version number to point the alias to.

skills.title: Skills
skills.description: Registry skill UUIDs; tool nodes use config.tool_name equal to skill.name. Built-in tools: echo, fetch, retrieve (RAG over /api/v1/knowledge/ingest).

run_async.title: Run Async
run_async.description: If true, run in background and stream events via SSE (requires Redis).

modality.title: Modality
modality.description: Training recipe. Only text_sft (Unsloth causal LM) is implemented.

dataset_path.title: Dataset Path
dataset_path.description: Hub: hf://org/dataset or hf://org/dataset/config (e.g. hf://openai/gsm8k/main). Multi-config datasets auto-pick 'main' when omitted.

prompt.title: Prompt
prompt.example: Create a research agent that searches the web

graph_schema_version.title: Graph Schema Version
graph_schema_version.description: AgentForge Graph (AFG) schema revision; JSON in DB is canonical.

parallel_nodes.title: Parallel Nodes
parallel_nodes.description: Optional hint: node ids intended for parallel execution (orchestrator-specific).

source_code.title: Source Code
source_code.default:
def run(x: str) -> str:
    return x

secret.title: Secret
secret.description: Optional HMAC-SHA256 secret for X-AgentForge-Signature header
